# Claude Face protocol v1 — byte layout

All integers little-endian. Strings are ASCII, NUL-padded, always NUL-terminated.

## Framing

- **line_prefix**: `#CF`
- **host_to_watch**: `#CF<type> <base64(payload || crc16le)>\n`
- **watch_to_host**: `#CF<type> <base64(payload || crc16le)>\n`
- **crc**: `CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF) over payload, appended little-endian`
- **query**: `host sends '#CFQ\n'; watch answers with a HELLO frame`
- `#CFS` — STATE (host -> watch)
- `#CFL` — SESSIONS (host -> watch)
- `#CFT` — TIME (host -> watch)
- `#CFE` — EVENT (watch -> host)
- `#CFH` — HELLO (watch -> host)

## State (`#CFS`) — 119 bytes

Global + primary-session snapshot. Sent on change (debounced 250 ms) and every 30 s heartbeat.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `version` | `u8` | protocol version (first byte of every message) |
| 1 | 2 | `seq` | `u16` | increments per STATE frame |
| 3 | 1 | `flags` | `u8` | Flags bits |
| 4 | 1 | `global_state` | `u8` | State: highest-priority state across sessions |
| 5 | 1 | `five_used` | `u8` | 5h window used %, 255 = unknown |
| 6 | 4 | `five_resets_at` | `u32` | epoch s, 0 = unknown |
| 10 | 1 | `seven_used` | `u8` | 7d window used %, 255 = unknown |
| 11 | 4 | `seven_resets_at` | `u32` | epoch s, 0 = unknown |
| 15 | 1 | `five_pace` | `i8` | used% - elapsed% for 5h, -128 = unknown |
| 16 | 1 | `seven_pace` | `i8` | used% - elapsed% for 7d, -128 = unknown |
| 17 | 4 | `projected_hit` | `u32` | epoch s when 5h limit is projected to be hit before reset, 0 = none |
| 21 | 2 | `rl_age_s` | `u16` | seconds since rate limits were last updated, 65535 = never |
| 23 | 1 | `five_elapsed` | `u8` | elapsed % of 5h window, 255 = unknown |
| 24 | 1 | `seven_elapsed` | `u8` | elapsed % of 7d window, 255 = unknown |
| 25 | 1 | `session_count` | `u8` | total live sessions |
| 26 | 1 | `blocked_count` | `u8` | sessions in BLOCKED |
| 27 | 1 | `subagent_count` | `u8` | running subagents in the primary session |
| 28 | 1 | `primary_index` | `u8` | index of the primary session in the SESSIONS rows, 255 = none |
| 29 | 1 | `p_state` | `u8` | State of primary session |
| 30 | 1 | `p_ctx` | `u8` | primary context used %, 255 = unknown |
| 31 | 1 | `p_model` | `u8` | Model |
| 32 | 1 | `p_effort` | `u8` | Effort |
| 33 | 1 | `p_flags` | `u8` | PFlags bits |
| 34 | 4 | `p_turn_elapsed_s` | `u32` | seconds since the current turn started (0 if none). Watch keeps ticking it locally while WORKING/BLOCKED. |
| 38 | 4 | `p_last_turn_s` | `u32` | duration of the last finished turn in s |
| 42 | 2 | `p_tool_count` | `u16` | tool calls this turn |
| 44 | 24 | `p_current_tool` | `char[24]` | tool + target, separator '|' (firmware draws it as a middle dot), e.g. 'Bash|npm test'. ASCII only. |
| 68 | 16 | `p_project` | `char[16]` | repo or project dir basename |
| 84 | 16 | `p_model_name` | `char[16]` | model.display_name, truncated |
| 100 | 4 | `p_cache_expires_at` | `u32` | epoch s, 0 = unknown |
| 104 | 2 | `p_lines_added` | `u16` | saturating |
| 106 | 2 | `p_lines_removed` | `u16` | saturating |
| 108 | 2 | `p_cost_cents` | `u16` | session cost estimate, 65535 = unknown |
| 110 | 2 | `cost_today_cents` | `u16` | sum over today's sessions, 65535 = unknown |
| 112 | 2 | `p_pr_number` | `u16` | 0 = none |
| 114 | 1 | `p_pr_review` | `u8` | PrReview |
| 115 | 4 | `bridge_now` | `u32` | bridge epoch s at send time |

## SessionRow — 18 bytes

One row of the SESSIONS message.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `state` | `u8` | State |
| 1 | 1 | `ctx` | `u8` | context used %, 255 = unknown |
| 2 | 12 | `project` | `char[12]` | project name |
| 14 | 4 | `turn_elapsed_s` | `u32` | seconds into current turn, 0 if none |

## Sessions (`#CFL`) — 76 bytes

Up to 4 sessions, most important first; STATE.primary_index points into rows.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `version` | `u8` | protocol version |
| 1 | 2 | `seq` | `u16` | increments per SESSIONS frame |
| 3 | 1 | `count` | `u8` | valid rows (0..4) |
| 4 | 72 | `rows` | `SessionRow[4]` | unused rows zeroed |

## Time (`#CFT`) — 7 bytes

Sent on every (re)connect and hourly. Watch writes the RV-3028.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `version` | `u8` | protocol version |
| 1 | 4 | `epoch` | `u32` | UTC epoch s |
| 5 | 2 | `utc_offset_min` | `i16` | local offset from UTC in minutes |

## Event (`#CFE`) — 5 bytes

Watch -> host.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `version` | `u8` | protocol version |
| 1 | 1 | `code` | `u8` | EventCode |
| 2 | 1 | `arg` | `u8` | SELECT_SESSION: row index; else 0 |
| 3 | 2 | `seq` | `u16` | watch event counter |

## Hello (`#CFH`) — 17 bytes

Watch -> host, on boot and on '#CFQ'.

| Off | Size | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | `version` | `u8` | protocol version the watch speaks |
| 1 | 16 | `fw` | `char[16]` | firmware id, e.g. 'AuroraOS cf1' |

## Enums

- **State**: NONE=0, IDLE=1, WORKING=2, COMPACTING=3, DONE=4, WAITING_INPUT=5, BLOCKED=6, LIMITED=7, STALE=8
- **Model**: UNKNOWN=0, OPUS=1, SONNET=2, HAIKU=3, FABLE=4, OTHER=5
- **Effort**: UNKNOWN=0, LOW=1, MEDIUM=2, HIGH=3, XHIGH=4, MAX=5
- **PrReview**: NONE=0, PENDING=1, APPROVED=2, CHANGES_REQUESTED=3, COMMENTED=4, DRAFT=5, MERGED=6, CLOSED=7, OTHER=8
- **EventCode**: ACK=1, SELECT_SESSION=2, HELLO_REQ=3, APPROVE=16, DENY=17
- **Flags** (bits): RL_STALE=0x01, INCIDENT=0x02, QUIET=0x04, BRIDGE_OK=0x08, NO_RATE_LIMITS=0x10, QUIET_HOURS=0x20
- **PFlags** (bits): FAST_MODE=0x01, THINKING=0x02, CACHE_WARM=0x04, HUNG=0x08, UNACKED_DONE=0x10, SELECTED=0x20
- **Sentinels**: PCT_UNKNOWN=255, PACE_UNKNOWN=-128, U16_UNKNOWN=65535
